description: This Kotlin file defines a DBHelper class that extends SQLiteOpenHelper to manage creation and upgrading of a local notes database within an Android application.

classes.name: DBHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing SQLite database creation and version management for notes data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the notes table and indexes when the database is first created.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database schema upgrades by dropping the existing table and recreating it.
